basic_info.description: Experience exceptional value in this modern studio, built in 2019. Overlooking a serene interior courtyard, this high-quality unit offers a peaceful retreat within the vibrant Dogpatch neighborhood.    The interior features wide plank hardwood oak floors, air conditioning, and large closets for ample storage. The kitchen is equipped with premium Bosch appliances, including a gas range/oven, refrigerator, and dishwasher, catering to all your culinary needs. Enjoy the convenience of in-unit laundry and access to a stunning shared rooftop deck featuring two BBQs, a dining table, fire pit, outdoor TV, and sun lounge chairsperfect for entertaining or unwinding while taking in panoramic bay views. Unlike many affordable options, this property is not part of the Below Market Rate (BMR) program, providing greater flexibility for discerning buyers.    Situated in a prime location, you're just two blocks from CalTrain, half a block from the T-line Muni, and two blocks from I-280, facilitating easy commutes. Nearby attractions include Pier 70 (two blocks away), the Chase Center (four blocks away), Uber HQ, and the UCSF campus. This studio is an excellent opportunity for long-term rental investment or as your personal urban haven.
